hero.title: Is Your Organization Ready to See Itself Clearly?
hero.description: COIREA is not for every organization. It is for the ones that sense something needs to shift, and are ready to look at it honestly, with the right support alongside them.
hero.note: Every organization that enters COIREA does so with a Guardian — a trained facilitator who holds the process with you. This is not a software subscription. It is an accompanied transformation. Applications are reviewed personally. If there is a genuine fit, a Guardian will reach out to begin the conversation.

steps.title: You apply
steps.description: Tell us about your organization and what you're sensing needs to change. There are no wrong answers.

steps.title: A Guardian reviews your application
steps.description: We read every application personally. If there is a genuine fit, a Guardian will reach out to schedule a Compass Call — a first conversation to understand your system together.

steps.title: You enter SOIL
steps.description: The process begins with the OVI assessment and the Reflection Board. Free, no commitment. You see your system. Then you decide if you want to go deeper.
